Option Explicit
Option Base 0

Public Function CodegenGeometry() As Variant
    Dim lines As Variant
    Dim circles As Variant
    ReDim lines(0 To 0)
    lines(0) = Array(Array(0.0#, 0.0#, 0.0#), Array(1.0#, 2.0#, 3.0#))
    ReDim circles(0 To 0)
    circles(0) = Array(Array(0.0#, 0.0#, 0.0#), 1.0#)
    CodegenGeometry = Array(lines, circles)
End Function
